messages:
Priya: Heads-up team  quick pre-QBR on Atlasica (mid-market) next week. Need a compact cost package: 60/90d token trend, top 3 token drivers, and one-page customer ops ask. Who takes forecasts, who runs prompt triage, and who drafts the ask?
Ethan: Ill run the forecast (60/90d) and a simple scenario matrix (base / +30% marketing push / -12% after optim). Will grab weekly burn and peak-day flags. ETA: EOD.
Marta: I can sample the top 800 calls and tag families. Suspect heavy embedding waves + long-doc summarization. Will annotate avg tokens/call and quick mitigation per family.
Ravi: Ill draft the one-pager with 3 asks: temporary quota increase, 1 sprint dev for prompt trimming, and an enablement session for their engineers. Will include suggested CS email wording.
Priya: For alerts, flag anything >18% MTD or a single-day >30% of monthly tokens. Also call out bursty embedding batches >2M tokens/day.
quota-bot: Console alert rule created: MTD +18% and single-day >30% share. Owners: @Priya, @Ethan.
Ethan: Quick back-of-envelope from billing view: current MRR $9.2k, avg tokens/day ~850k, est monthly infer cost ~$2.6k. CSV link to follow: https://redwood.internal/forecasts/1832109991
Marta: Sample prompt families Im seeing:
- bulk-embed: avg 9.8k tokens/call (nightly batches)
- long-summary: avg 18k tokens/call (podcast transcripts)
- multi-email-gen: avg 6.5k tokens/call (few-shot templates)
Mitigations: schedule embeds midnight, enable prefix cache for transcripts, trim few-shot examples from 4->2.
Ethan: Uploaded forecast CSV: /team-shared/atlasica/forecasts/1832109991.csv (includes base, +30%, -12% scenarios). Snippet:
```
Scenario,EstMonthlyCost
Base,$2,600
Activation+30%,$3,380
Optimized-12%,$2,288
```
Ravi: One-pager draft will have: 3 asks, short risk note, and an ops contact. Ill post WIP to #customer-docs and tag Atlasica owners.
Priya: Add a short live poll in the enablement: 1) which jobs can be deferred to nightly windows? 2) which outputs could accept lower fidelity? Capture two example prompts theyd accept lower fidelity on.
Marta: Ill add a cost/perf table with per-prompt token impact and suggested token-savings % if we apply batching + caching.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Atlasica QBR prep Wed 9:30am PT. Participants: Priya, Ethan, Marta, Ravi, Atlasica-SE.
Ethan: Also added a peak-day detector to watch next 48h. Will post here if we see >20% day-over-day spike.
Priya: Thanks all. If we need an emergency quota bump during the QBR, well route through @quota-bot with the one-pager attached. :thumbsup:
